title: MicroSim Uniqueness Interactive Venn Diagram
description: An interactive three-circle Venn diagram demonstrating what makes MicroSims unique at the intersection of Simplicity, Accessibility, and AI Generation.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: MicroSim
learningObjectives: Identify the three defining characteristics of MicroSims represented by the circles: Simplicity, Accessibility, and AI Generation
Distinguish the seven regions of a three-circle Venn diagram: three single circles, three pairwise overlaps, and the central triple intersection
Explain why MicroSims sit at the center where all three characteristics converge rather than in any single circle or pairwise overlap
Compare the pairwise overlaps, such as Simplicity with AI Generation, to describe what each combination alone fails to deliver
